evidence.name: Screen field: Legal links row spacing
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Legal links row spacing" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Legal links row spacing
sections.description: Adds padding around the whole row of legal links — Restore, Terms, and Privacy together — on each side: top, bottom, left, and right (left/right flip for right-to-left languages). The defaults are fine; this is optional fine-tuning. Add a little top and bottom spacing so the links sit clearly below the disclosure without crowding.
